mapper.select: select count(1) from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId} and pos_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.sql: select eqs_id as questionId, eqs_type as type, eqs_content as content, eqs_options_json as optionsJson, eqs_answer as answer, eqs_score as score, eqs_difficulty as difficulty, eqs_skill_tag as skillTag, date_format(eqs_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as createdAt from t_exam_question
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_question (eqs_type, eqs_content, eqs_options_json, eqs_answer, eqs_score, eqs_difficulty, eqs_skill_tag) values (#{type}, #{content}, #{optionsJson}, #{answer}, #{score}, #{difficulty}, #{skillTag})
mapper.update: update t_exam_question set eqs_type = #{type}, eqs_content = #{content}, eqs_options_json = #{optionsJson}, eqs_answer = #{answer}, eqs_score = #{score}, eqs_difficulty = #{difficulty}, eqs_skill_tag = #{skillTag}, eqs_updated_at = now() where eqs_id = #{id}
mapper.select: select p.epa_id as paperId, p.epa_name as name, p.epa_position_id as positionId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, p.epa_total_score as totalScore, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, p.epa_rule_json as ruleJson, p.epa_status as status from t_exam_paper p join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = p.epa_position_id where p.epa_id = #{paperId} and pos.pos_company_id = #{companyId}

select q.epq_id as relId, q.epq_question_id as questionId, q.epq_score as score, q.epq_sort_order as sortOrder, t.eqs_type as type, t.eqs_content as content, t.eqs_options_json as optionsJson, t.eqs_answer as answer, t.eqs_difficulty as difficulty, t.eqs_skill_tag as skillTag from t_exam_paper_question q join t_exam_question t on t.eqs_id = q.epq_question_id where q.epq_paper_id = #{paperId} order by q.epq_sort_order, q.epq_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_paper (epa_name, epa_position_id, epa_total_score, epa_duration_min, epa_rule_json, epa_status) values (#{name}, #{positionId}, #{totalScore}, #{durationMin}, #{ruleJson}, 1)
mapper.update: update t_exam_paper set epa_name = #{name}, epa_total_score = #{totalScore}, epa_duration_min = #{durationMin}, epa_rule_json = #{ruleJson}, epa_status = #{status}, epa_updated_at = now() where epa_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_paper_question (epq_paper_id, epq_question_id, epq_score, epq_sort_order) values (#{paperId}, #{questionId}, #{score}, #{sortOrder})
mapper.select: select s.esd_id as scheduleId, s.esd_position_id as positionId, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, s.esd_paper_id as paperId, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_duration_min as durationMin, p.epa_total_score as totalScore, date_format(s.esd_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as startAt, date_format(s.esd_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as endAt, s.esd_max_attempts as maxAttempts, s.esd_pass_threshold as passThreshold, s.esd_force_dual_camera as forceDualCamera, s.esd_dual_camera_config_json as dualCameraConfig, s.esd_submit_rule_json as submitRule, s.esd_notify_config_json as notifyConfig, s.esd_auto_flow_json as autoFlow, s.esd_status as status from t_exam_schedule s join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id where s.esd_id = #{scheduleId} and pos.pos_company_id = #{companyId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_schedule (esd_position_id, esd_paper_id, esd_start_at, esd_end_at, esd_max_attempts, esd_pass_threshold, esd_force_dual_camera, esd_dual_camera_config_json, esd_submit_rule_json, esd_auto_flow_json, esd_status) values (#{positionId}, #{paperId}, #{startAt}, #{endAt}, #{maxAttempts}, #{passThreshold}, #{forceDualCamera}, #{dualCameraConfig}, #{submitRule}, #{autoFlow}, 0)
mapper.update: update t_exam_schedule set esd_paper_id = #{paperId}, esd_start_at = #{startAt}, esd_end_at = #{endAt}, esd_max_attempts = #{maxAttempts}, esd_pass_threshold = #{passThreshold}, esd_force_dual_camera = #{forceDualCamera}, esd_dual_camera_config_json = #{dualCameraConfig}, esd_submit_rule_json = #{submitRule}, esd_auto_flow_json = #{autoFlow}, esd_updated_at = now() where esd_id = #{id}

update t_exam_schedule set esd_status = case when now() > esd_end_at then 2 else 1 end, esd_updated_at = now() where (esd_status = 0 and now() >= esd_start_at) or (esd_status in (0, 1) and now() > esd_end_at)
mapper.select: select count(1) from t_exam_schedule where esd_paper_id = #{paperId} and esd_status in (0, 1)

select t.tal_id as talId, u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as name, u.email as email, u.phonenumber as phone, date_format(a.app_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as appliedAt from t_exam_schedule s join t_app_record a on a.app_position_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id and t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where s.esd_id = #{scheduleId} order by a.app_id
mapper.insert: insert into t_msg (msg_receiver_id, msg_sender_id, msg_type, msg_title, msg_content, msg_is_read) values (#{receiverId}, 0, 5, #{title}, #{content}, 0)
